sources.title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo - TechCrunch
sources.snippet: One such startup, Underdog, has released a game built with its new voice model called Woof that’s only 32MB large. The game features a room with a retro tech theme, a typewriter, and a CRT monitor.
